name: Marble Mountains
kicker: The marble hill on the Hoi An road
summary: Climb Thuy Son, the marble hill on the road to Hoi An, up stone stairs into caves and pagodas and out to lookouts over the coast. Give it a morning on the way south. Buy the hill, skip the other peaks, and keep Hoi An for the afternoon.
getThere: 81 Huyen Tran Cong Chua, about 15 minutes from the center. Hoi An is about 30 minutes further.
heroCaption: The marble cliff above the town at its foot

notice.title: Am Phu is a second ticket
notice.body: Thuy Son is 40,000 VND. Am Phu cave is another 20,000 VND for an adult. The elevator is extra too. Buy the hill, and stop, if Hoi An is the rest of the day.

body: Climb Thuy Son. The range has six peaks, and this is the one visitors climb. Inside the hill are caves, Tam Thai pagoda, Linh Ung on the hill, and lookouts over the coast. Allow 3 to 4 hours for the fuller morning.

Tickets are at Gate 01 or Gate 02. Adults pay 40,000 VND for Thuy Son. Students pay 10,000 VND. Children under 6 are free. The elevator is 15,000 VND one way and 30,000 VND return. Am Phu cave is a second ticket: 20,000 VND for an adult, 7,000 VND for a student, free under 6.

The hill sits at 81 Huyen Tran Cong Chua, about 8 kilometers and about 15 minutes from the center, on the way to Hoi An. From the hills to Hoi An by the coastal road is about 30 minutes. Non Nuoc, the stone-carving village at the foot, has no ticket. Go only if the hill did not already take the morning.

figures.caption: The stair inside Huyen Khong cave
figures.alt: A stone stair inside a Marble Mountains cave, with painted guardians on both sides

gettingThere: The hills are in Ngu Hanh Son ward, southeast of the center, on the coast road toward Hoi An. Go by car or Grab to 81 Huyen Tran Cong Chua, about 8 kilometers and about 15 minutes from the center. Hoi An is about 30 minutes on by the coastal road.

legs.heading: From Da Nang
legs.body: About 15 minutes by road from the center to 81 Huyen Tran Cong Chua.

legs.heading: Toward Hoi An
legs.body: About 30 minutes from the hills to Hoi An by the coastal road. Do the hill first if both are the same morning.

closed: No weekly closing day listed. Check on arrival.
admissionNote: Thuy Son: adults 40,000 VND, students 10,000 VND, children under 6 free. Elevator: 15,000 VND one way, 30,000 VND return. Am Phu cave: adults 20,000 VND, students 7,000 VND, under 6 free. The 2026 tourism price list and the Marble Mountains page give these figures. Tickets are at Gate 01 or Gate 02.
